answer: The copper index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1601 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the pulse. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the umber queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Bonded capital sits idle for 13 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
